newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Feb 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Feb 21.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Friday.
WASHINGTON - The United States has vowed to boycott a World Trade Organisation panel formed to judge the legality of Washington's economic sanctions against Cuba.

RICHMOND - Virginia legislators decided to require girls under 18 to notify a parent before having an abortion, a measure that represents the state's first restriction on the procedure since it was legalised 24 years ago.
WASHINGTON - Georgian diplomat Gueorgui Makharadze surrendered to face involuntary manslaughter charges in the traffic accident last month that killed a 16-year-old girl.

WASHINGTON - The National Transportation Safety Board, investigating two mysterious Boeing 737 crashes, urged federal aviation officials to take action to replace the rudder system on the popular jet.
BEIJING - China began six days of mourning for Deng Xiaoping.
WASHINGTON - Civil rights groups are wary of a plan to use computers to identify passengers who should face extra scrutiny from airport security officials.
